items: An oat or soy barista milk for every drink, so any drink can be made plant-based.
One plant-based pastry, muffin or bar at the counter.
Mark which syrups and sauces are plant-based on the menu board.
A dairy-free whipped topping for the drinks that come with whipped cream.
A barista edition plant milk (oat or soy steam best) and a second one people ask for, such as almond.
Syrups and sauces whose labels say no milk.
A plant-based creamer for the self-serve station.
Caramel, white mocha and pumpkin sauces often contain milk. Read the label.
Whipped cream and milk chocolate are dairy.
Honey comes from bees, so it is not plant-based.
Butter or an egg wash on pastries, and glazes made with milk.
gates: Each with first items, what to stock and what to watch for. Take the short survey about your business and the whole Guide opens. Free, no card.
